weeks.title: Introduction to Digital Literacy & Hardware Components
outcomes:
By the end of the lesson the learner should be able to:
Define digital literacy and state 3 workplace benefits within 15 min.
 Differentiate 5 ICT tools and their uses in group activity.
Explain how digital literacy supports employability in 5 min presentation.

Identify 5 internal and 5 external components in 15 min.
 Explain functions of CPU, RAM, and storage.
 Classify 12 devices as input/output/storage in 10 min.

weeks.title: Input & Output Devices & Basic Computer Operation
outcomes:
Identify 5 input and 5 output devices in 15 min.
Explain one real-world use of each.
 Connect and use an external device in 10 min.

Demonstrate startup and shutdown twice in 10 min.
Apply 5 keyboard shortcuts.
Customize wallpaper/screensaver in 15 min.

weeks.title: Introduction to Word Processing
outcomes:
Create and save a new document in 10 min.
Open, close, rename 2 docs in 15 min.
 Switch between 2 docs in 5 min.

weeks.title: Software Classification & OS Fundamentals & User Needs Analysis & Requirement Documentation & Software Licensing & Legal Compliance & Pre-Installation Planning & Data Backup
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Classify software as system or application
2. Identify OS types from descriptions
3. Match OS functions to definitions
4. Create a software categorization chart

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Conduct a mock client interview
2. Document functional requirements
3. Identify resource requirements
4. Prepare a needs assessment report

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Evaluate software against a checklist
2. Compare single-user vs. multi-user licenses
3. Analyze a sample EULA
4. Justify software selection with reasoning

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1.Develop a pre-installation checklist
2. Perform a data backup on external drive
3. Verify backup integrity
4. Create a backup verification report

weeks.title: Bootable Media Creation & Verification & Attended OS Installation & Configuration & Clean vs Upgrade Installation Performance Analysis & Unattended Installation & Automation Scripting
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Create a bootable USB for Windows
2. Create a bootable USB for Linux
3. Verify USB integrity using checksum
4. Test boot on a lab machine

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Install Windows 10 step-by-step
2. Configure regional settings and user accounts
3. Troubleshoot a simulated installation error
4. Document the installation process

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Perform a clean OS installation
2. Perform an in-place upgrade
3. Compare performance before/after
4. Recommend installation type for a scenario

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Create an unattended installation answer file
2. Test the script in a VM
3. Modify script for a different hardware profile
4. Document the automation process

weeks.title: Productivity Software Installation & Configuration & Security Software Implementation & Management & Network-Based Software Deployment & Software License Management & Activation
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Install a productivity software suite
2. Configure application settings
3. Activate software with a license key
4. Create desktop shortcuts and start menu entries

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Install antivirus software
2. Configure real-time scanning
3. Schedule a weekly full scan
4. Update virus definitions

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Set up a network installation share
2. Deploy software to 2 workstations
3. Monitor deployment progress
4. Verify installation on target machines

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Register a trial software online
2. Apply an activation key
3. Troubleshoot activation failure
4. Maintain a license inventory

weeks.title: User Account Management & Security Policies & Software Customization & Template Development & Configuration Control & Version Management & Installation Practical Assessment
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Create local user accounts (admin, standard, guest)
2. Configure password policies
3. Assign user groups and permissions
4. Test account access controls

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Customize software interface settings
2. Create a configuration template
3. Export and import settings
4. Document configuration changes

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Implement simple version control for confit files
2. Track changes to configurations
3. Roll back to a previous configuration
4. Document version history

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Complete end-to-end software installation
2. Configure software as per specification
3. Document entire process
4. Demonstrate safety and compliance

weeks.title: Test Planning & Requirement Analysis & Installation Verification & Validation & Functional Testing & Defect Management & Usability & Accessibility Compliance Testing
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to;
 1. Analyze software requirements for testability
2. Develop a test plan
3. Create 5 test cases
4. Identify test data needs

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Verify software installation completeness
2. Test installation on different hardware
3. Document verification results
4. Identify any missing components

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Execute functional test cases
2. Document pass/fail results
3. Identify and classify defects
4. Prioritize defects for fixing

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Conduct a usability test with a peer
2. Check software against accessibility guidelines
3. Document usability issues
4. Suggest improvements

weeks.title: Error Handling & Resilience Testing & Cross-Platform Compatibility Testing & Performance Testing & Resource Monitoring & Basic Security Testing & Vulnerability Assessment
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Test software with invalid inputs
2. Verify error messages are helpful
3. Document error handling behavior
4. Suggest error message improvements

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Test software on different OS versions
2. Test with different screen resolutions
3. Document compatibility results
4. Create a compatibility matrix

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Measure software startup time
2. Test under multi-tasking load
3. Monitor CPU and memory usage
4. Document performance metrics

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Test password strength enforcement
2. Verify data encryption in transit
3. Check user permission boundaries
4. Document security findings

weeks.title: Introduction to Test Automation & Defect Reporting & Lifecycle Management & Test Reporting & Stakeholder Communication & Testing Practical Assessment
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Record a simple automated test
2. Playback the recorded test
3. Modify the test script
4. Analyze automation results

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Document a defect with reproduction steps
2. Assign severity and priority
3. Track defect status
4. Create a defect resolution report

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Compile all test results
2. Analyze test coverage
3. Create an executive test summary
4. Make a release recommendation

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Design a test strategy for given software
2. Execute comprehensive testing
3. Document all findings
4. Present test conclusions

weeks.title: Maintenance Planning & Scheduling & Patch Management & Security Updates & Version Upgrade Planning & Execution & Driver Management & Hardware Troubleshooting
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Categorize maintenance tasks
2. Develop a 1-month maintenance schedule
3. Prioritize tasks based on urgency
4. Allocate time and resources

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Identify available OS and software patches
2. Evaluate patch criticality
3. Apply a security patch
4. Verify patch installation

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Plan a software version upgrade
2. Backup before upgrade
3. Execute the upgrade
4. Validate post-upgrade functionality

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Identify outdated drivers
2. Source correct driver versions
3. Update a device driver
4. Troubleshoot a driver conflict

weeks.title: Performance Monitoring & Baseline Establishment & Software Optimization & System Tuning & Event Log Analysis & Problem Diagnosis & Preventive Maintenance & Automation
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Configure performance monitoring tools
2. Establish a performance baseline
3. Monitor CPU, memory, disk usage
4. Identify performance degradation

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Clean temporary files and cache
2. Optimize startup programs
3. Defragment disk (if HDD)
4. Document optimization results

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Access and filter system event logs
2. Identify critical errors and warnings
3. Correlate events with user-reported issues
4. Document analysis findings

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Schedule weekly and monthly maintenance tasks
2. Create a preventive maintenance checklist
3. Automate a routine maintenance task
4. Document preventive measures

weeks.title: Structured Troubleshooting Methodology & User Support & Knowledge Management & Maintenance Documentation & Reporting & Disaster Recovery Planning & Testing
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Apply a structured troubleshooting approach
2. Isolate software vs. hardware issues
3. Use diagnostic tools effectively
4. Document troubleshooting steps

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Handle a user-reported issue ticket
2. Create a support knowledge base article
3. Deliver basic user training on a feature
4. Gather user feedback

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Create a maintenance record for all work done
2. Update configuration documentation
3. Prepare a monthly maintenance report
4. Peer-review maintenance documentation

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Develop a software recovery plan
2. Create a system restore point
3. Test recovery from backup
4. Document recovery steps

weeks.title: Integrated Maintenance Project & Maintenance Practical Assessment & Final Theory Assessment & Portfolio Submission
outcomes:
By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Plan a full maintenance cycle for a given system
2. Execute installation, testing, and maintenance tasks
3. Document the entire process
4. Present outcomes to peers

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Demonstrate competency in maintenance tasks
2. Handle a simulated real-world scenario
3. Apply safety and procedural standards
4. Complete tasks within time limit

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Recall key concepts from all modules
2. Apply knowledge to scenario-based questions
3. Demonstrate understanding of best practices
4. Complete written exam within time

By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to; 
1. Compile complete competency portfolio
2. Present evidence for all learning outcomes
3. Receive final feedback
4. Develop a continuous improvement plan

weeks.title: Identify information system concepts & Classification of Information systems
outcomes:
By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate understanding of the key components of an information system
- Apply the concept of data, information, and knowledge in the context of an information system
- Demonstrate the role of information systems in supporting organizational functions and decision-making
- Design a simple information system to address a specific organizational need

By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate the ability to classify information systems based on their purpose and functionality
- Apply the principles of information system classification to analyze the components and capabilities of a given information system
- Design a conceptual model for a new information system based on its intended purpose and target users
- Troubleshoot common issues related to the classification and implementation of information systems

weeks.title: Information systems processing requirements & functional areas of Management information system
outcomes:
By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate the ability to identify the key components of an information system and their functions
- Apply the principles of data processing to analyze and interpret information system data
- Design a simple information system to meet specific processing requirements
- Troubleshoot common issues in information system processing and suggest appropriate solutions

By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate the role of Management Information Systems (MIS) in supporting business operations and decision-making
- Apply the principles of data management to ensure the integrity, security, and accessibility of information within an MIS
- Analyze the role of information systems in supporting organizational decision-making and problem-solving
- Design a basic MIS solution to address a specific business need

weeks.title: Information resource management concepts & Information systems resources
outcomes:
By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate the ability to identify and classify different types of information resources
- Apply effective search strategies to locate relevant information resources
- Design a system for organizing and managing information resources
- Implement strategies for evaluating the reliability and credibility of information resources

By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate the use of common productivity software for information management
- Apply basic database management principles to store and retrieve information
- Configure network devices and services to enable information sharing and communication
- Design and implement a simple information system to address a specific organizational need

weeks.title: Importance of managing information resources & Definition and importance of information systems planning
outcomes:
By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate the ability to identify and classify different types of information resources
- Apply strategies for effectively searching and retrieving relevant information from various sources
- Implement best practices for organizing and managing personal information resources
- Design a plan for maintaining the security and integrity of information resources

By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Define the concept of information systems planning and its key components
- Demonstrate the importance of effective information systems planning for organizational success
- Apply the principles of information systems planning to develop a basic plan for a given scenario
- Analyze the potential challenges and barriers to effective information systems planning

weeks.title: Information systems planning process and techniques & Types of Information systems Acquisition methods
outcomes:
By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate the process of information systems planning, including needs assessment, goal setting, and strategy development
- Apply techniques for gathering and analyzing information systems requirements, including stakeholder interviews, process mapping, and data flow diagramming
- Design an information systems architecture that aligns with organizational goals and constraints, incorporating hardware, software, and network components
- Implement a project management plan for an information systems implementation, including resource allocation, timeline management, and risk mitigation

By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate the process of in-house development of an information system
- Apply the principles of commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software acquisition to select an appropriate information system
- Demonstrate the process of customizing a COTS information system to meet specific organizational requirements
- Design a plan for outsourcing the development of an information system

weeks.title: Trends of Information systems & Ethical and legal issues in information systems
outcomes:
By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate understanding of emerging trends in information systems and their impact on organizations
- Apply design principles to develop a prototype of a mobile application that addresses a business need
- Implement a basic data analytics solution to support decision-making in a business scenario
- Troubleshoot and resolve common issues in a cloud-based information system

By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate understanding of key ethical principles in information systems management
- Apply legal and regulatory requirements for data privacy and protection in information systems
- Implement security measures to prevent cybercrime and unethical use of information systems
- Design an ethical code of conduct for IT professionals in an organization

weeks.title: Information systems maintenance
outcomes:
By the end of the lesson, trainees should be able to:
- Demonstrate the process of performing routine hardware and software maintenance on a computer system
- Apply appropriate software update and patch management techniques to maintain the security and stability of an information system
- Troubleshoot and resolve common network connectivity issues in an information system
- Design and implement a preventive maintenance plan for an information system
